cards.card_text: The Levites have no portion of land, because their inheritance is the ___ of the LORD.
cards.verse_text: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD.
cards.snippet: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD.

cards.card_text: How long does he say their inheritance will last?
cards.verse_text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
cards.snippet: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

cards.card_text: David says God has given him the inheritance reserved for those who fear His name.
cards.verse_text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
cards.snippet: …You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

cards.card_text: What does He say their inheritance is?
cards.verse_text: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance.
cards.snippet: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance.

cards.card_text: He will rest and then arise to his inheritance He will be taken up to heaven alive He will rule over the Beautiful Land

cards.card_text: Paul also wants them to know "the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints…" And he says all of it lines up with the working of God's mighty strength, the strength He exerted in Christ.

cards.snippet: …may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints, and the surpassing greatness of His power to us…

cards.card_text: Paul says an immoral, impure or greedy person still has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
cards.verse_text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
cards.snippet: …No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
